messages:
incident-bot: Paging incident: SEV-2 - multiple 5xx errors observed for customer 'Krypton' in eu-central-1 (dedicated pool krtn-prod-euc1). Runbook: <https://redwood.runbooks/rotational-failover>. Pager: oncall-alex.
oncall-alex: got the page. I'm on it. Initial check: metrics show a steady increase in request latency and 502 spike starting ~2932109800.
sre-janet: I'm looking at the serving runtime dashboards — KV cache eviction rate is high on krtn's shard, memory pressure on two pods. Could be noisy neighbor causing OOMs.
eng-jay: confirmed logs show repeated oom-kill on node g4e-07 in the dedicated pool. App logs show `Err: cache miss fallback -> model load` which is spiking token generation times.
support-ravi: CS reports customer-facing errors: multiple API clients getting 5xx, some timeouts. Customer support ticket KRTN-548 opened by cs-lucas at 2932109955.
cs-lucas: Customer reports their dashboard shows 40% request failures for a subset of their tenants, specifically tenant-id: t-krypton-42. They want ETA and mitigation.
oncall-alex: immediate mitigation plan suggestion: 1) isolate t-krypton-42 to stop noisy processes; 2) shift a percentage of traffic to warm pool in eu-west-1; 3) start DNS weight change for internal private zone with short TTL; 4) scale up warm capacity. Thoughts?
sre-janet: agree. For isolation: we can apply a routing rule to drain tenant from problematic nodes: `rwctl tenant route set --tenant t-krypton-42 --route isolated-pool` (this will send to an isolated dedicated warm pool). I'll prepare the route.
eng-jay: I'll stand by to increase warm pool in eu-west-1: scaling `krtn-warm-euw` from 8 -> 24 GPUs. Triggering now via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: rollout started: scale group krtn-warm-euw -> target 24 GPUs. Expected ready ~5m. Progress: 0/24 initializing.
dns-olivia: For DNS: we control Krypton's private hosted zone in Route53 (hz-krypton-internal). TTL currently 60s, we can do weighted routing to shift 30% to eu-west warm pool first, then ramp. I can prepare change batch.
solutions-maria: Customer asked for no cold restarts on their side. Can we ensure sticky session continuity for the portion that shifts? Need to preserve KV cache affinity when possible.
sre-janet: we'll do session affinity on the router for the shifted traffic; also enable `prefix_cache_restore` to preprime caches for the warm nodes. I'll trigger prewarm LRU fetch for top prompt prefixes.
oncall-alex: action list: A) isolate tenant via route set (janet) B) scale warm pool (jay) C) weighted DNS change 30% (olivia) D) start cache prewarm job (janet) E) notify customer + CS (lucas) F) monitor error rate and latency (alex). I'll own coordination.
sre-janet: running command now: ```
rwctl tenant route set --tenant t-krypton-42 --route isolated-pool --mode gradual --drain 10
```
eng-jay: scale progress: 6/24 ready. G4 nodes spinning up. GPU images pulling.
deploy-bot: scale group krtn-warm-euw: 12/24 ready.
dns-olivia: preparing Route53 change: ```json
{
  "ChangeBatch": {
    "Changes": [
      {
        "Action": "UPSERT",
        "ResourceRecordSet": {
          "Name": "api.krypton.internal.",
          "Type": "A",
          "SetIdentifier": "euc1-primary",
          "Weight": 70,
          "ResourceRecords": [{"Value": "10.2.3.4"}]
        }
      },
      {
        "Action": "UPSERT",
        "ResourceRecordSet": {
          "Name": "api.krypton.internal.",
          "Type": "A",
          "SetIdentifier": "euw-warm",
          "Weight": 30,
          "ResourceRecords": [{"Value": "10.8.9.10"}]
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
``` Scheduling to apply in 30s. TTL remains 60.
support-ravi: cc @cs-lucas crafting customer message: short update that we're shifting 30% to warm pool to reduce errors; estimate 10-15 minutes for stabilization. Will provide follow-ups.
cs-lucas: updated customer: "We're routing a fraction of your traffic to a healthy warm pool in eu-west-1 to reduce failures. We'll follow up with timelines." They asked to be notified when >90% success.
sre-janet: prewarm job started: `cache-prewarm --tenant t-krypton-42 --top-prefixes 2000 --target-pool krtn-warm-euw`. Mirroring top KV entries. ETA ~180s.
oncall-alex: DNS change applied. Waiting for weighted routing to reflect. Start monitoring error rate.
eng-jay: warm pool now 24/24 ready. All services healthy on new nodes.
deploy-bot: scale complete: 24/24 ready.
dns-olivia: Route53 change status: INSYNC. Weighted routing active.
monitoring: alert: error-rate for t-krypton-42 dropped from 38% -> 12% in 90s. Latency median reduced from 420ms -> 180ms.
sre-janet: still seeing a tail of 5xx from older euc1 nodes (drain mode). I'll bump drain to 40 now to accelerate. `rwctl tenant route set --tenant t-krypton-42 --drain 40`
oncall-alex: ok do it. Also set a temporary fallback policy so that if we see >20% errors in warm pool we rollback weights. `rwctl policy set --fallback weighted-roll-back --threshold 20`
eng-jay: implemented circuit for fallback test hook.
support-ravi: customer acknowledges update and appreciates the quick response. Asking about root cause. We'll tell them preliminary: noisy tenant process causing OOMs triggering excessive model loads on the dedicated pool nodes.
sre-janet: capturing heap/eviction traces for postmortem and will save logs to S3: `s3://redwood-incident-archive/krypton/2932109999/`
cs-lucas: customer requested a short post-incident call. I'll schedule for later today and add eng-jay and janet.
oncall-alex: handoff: I'm going to hand this to daytime oncall (sre-janet) in 20m for monitoring and postmortem. If anything regresses before then, ping me.
sre-janet: I have it. Will continue to watch and collect artifacts. Creating follow-up ticket: INC-2932109999-FOLLOWUP.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to: "Mitigated (traffic shifted, warm pool healthy)". Duration so far: 6m.
oncall-alex: thanks team — nice coordinated run. Postmortem owner: sre-janet, follow-up owner: cs-lucas. I'll close the primary page after handoff.
sre-janet: quick note for postmortem: investigate pod OOM pattern, autoscaler thresholds, and consider adding tenant-level burst isolation to avoid dedicated pool disruption.
cs-lucas: scheduled customer call at 1600 UTC. Sharing notes.
eng-jay: will prepare a candidate mitigation patch to avoid model reload storms on cache misses.
support-ravi: closing customer-facing ticket with status: mitigated, monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident closed for paging (handoff to follow-up)"
